text:
mira: heads-up: propose a small left-panel IA change to group sidebar items into 3 primary zones: Workspaces / Model registry / Insights. Primary goals: reduce scanning time for new users, simplify deep-linking, and make keyboard navigation predictable. attaching quick notes + route examples.

mira: Canonical routes we want to support:
```
/app/ws/:wsId
/app/ws/:wsId/registry/:modelId
/app/ws/:wsId/registry/:modelId/config
/app/ws/:wsId/insights/requests?range=7d
```

lee: suggestion: rename "Models & Assets" -> "Model registry" (shorter, clearer). Keep "Assets" as a sublabel in tooltip if needed.

jon: engineering POV: prefer full path-based routing (no hash). Hash-based nav makes copy/paste and browser history unpredictable. We'll migrate to react-router paths.

priya: PM: path routes also make external deep-links (emails, SSO) more reliable. Need plan for existing bookmarked hashes.

mira: plan: server-side redirect shim for old `/#/...` links for 6 months + a banner in console to surface the change.

sam: accessibility checklist:
- each zone header should be a navigation landmark (role="navigation" aria-label).
- breadcrumbs: aria-current="page" on last crumb.
- when moving active items due to collapse, announce via aria-live polite.
- add explicit tab stops between zones.

jon: quick implementation sketch:
```
<Routes>
  <Route path="/app/ws/:wsId" element={<WorkspaceShell />}>
    <Route path="registry/:modelId" element={<ModelPage/>} />
    <Route path="insights/:view" element={<Insights/>} />
  </Route>
</Routes>
```

jon: migration shim: on app mount, detect legacy hash `/#/ws/:id...` -> compute canonical pathname and do a replaceState or 301 redirect. We'll add server-side redirect rules for SEO clients.

lee: UX nit: breadcrumbs in compact narrow windows should collapse middle segments to ellipsis (Workspace > … > ModelName) rather than wrap lines.

mira: agree. Also prefer concise breadcrumb labels: show `WorkspaceName > ModelName` instead of `WorkspaceName > Registry > ModelName` visually while keeping full path in URL.

priya: rollout plan: feature-flag per workspace, canary to 5-10% sessions in staging, monitor click-depth, page-exits, and search within console. If degradation >10% we'll roll back.

sam: keyboard behavior: arrow keys to move within zone lists, Home/End to jump to first/last item in zone. Enter/Space to open deep links. Focus ring: 2px high-contrast outline token.\n
jon: will prototype arrows + focus handling. Also add unit tests for history push/replace semantics.

mira: docs + customer comms: priya to draft migration email for major saved-link owners. leave a prominent banner in UI for 6 months.

qa-bot: test-run: created staging job for "left-panel-ia" suite (ETA 4h).

priya: assign:
- mira: finalize mocks & copy (Thu)
- jon: react-router prototype + legacy-hash shim (start tomorrow)
- sam: a11y test plan + keyboard flows (next Tue)
- priya: customer migration draft & rollout plan (Mon)

mira: good. consensus seems to be path-based routing, condensed visual breadcrumbs, aria landmarks for zones, and a migration shim. jon to own PR and flag for design review.

lee: tiny thing: make sure the left-panel separators are focusable so keyboard users can skip zones quickly.

jon: noted. I'll post the staging preview link once the prototype is up.

mira: thanks all. closing this thread, will follow up in Fri design review.
